items.proposed: MGMT, exploratory_correlative, candidate_matched false (no selection biomarker)
items.reason: D31-A8: inclusion only requires records 'documenting ... (MGMT) promoter methylation status analysis' or tissue 'for MGMT status determination', with no required value, so MGMT is testing, not selection; never candidate-matched (OKN-007 is not MGMT-targeting).
No tumour biomarker value is required for entry; the MGMT clause is a documentation/tissue-availability requirement and any MGMT status is acceptable.

note: Temozolomide rechallenge in every patient is coded soc_backbone by both coders (not queued); the question is OKN-007 ('OKN-007 Combined With Temozolomide'). D31-A8 settles the MGMT clause (testing, not selection).

revisions.from: no selection biomarker (MGMT not an eligibility row)
revisions.to: MGMT, exploratory_correlative, candidate_matched false (no selection biomarker)
revisions.reason: The record requires only that MGMT methylation status be documented or determinable ('must have medical records available documenting ... MGMT promoter methylation status analysis'), with no required value.
Under D31-A8 the MGMT 'status must be known' clause is exploratory_correlative, so no eligibility or enrichment biomarker remains.
